translate_en|mods/NoStressBuddy/42/media: Keeps farm animals at zero stress. Bulls and rams no longer charge, stressed animals no longer break fences, and taming runs at full speed. Wild animals are left alone.

An animal born with the craven genetic defect always flees, whatever its stress and familiarity: the game decides before it even reads them. The mod strips that defect from farm animals. The genome is left alone: offspring still inherit it and the genetics screen still shows it. Uncheck to keep your craven animals craven.
Farm animals stop bolting when a zombie comes into view. The trade-off: an animal no longer moves away from a zombie that gets inside the pen. Wild animals are left alone.

Farm animals are kept at least this familiar with every player. The game stops making an animal run at 40 familiarity: below that it bolts on distance alone, whatever its stress level. Default 50, for a little margin. Set to 0 to leave taming exactly as vanilla. Wild animals are never tamed by this.
